name: Anakin
tagline: Live web data: scrape, crawl, search, research and pre-built actions on 1,000+ sites
description: Anakin's hosted MCP server gives Cline live web data with 22 tools. Scrape a page to clean markdown or structured JSON, map and crawl whole sites, run AI web search and multi-source deep research, and use Wire, a catalog of pre-built, tested actions on over 1,000 websites (search Amazon, read a LinkedIn profile, list Zillow homes). It can also monitor pages for changes, compare what ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overview answer to the same question, and drive a real cloud browser through multi-step tasks. Signs in with your Anakin account over OAuth, so there is no API key to copy; new accounts get 300 free credits.
